classic.title: Classic
classic.desc: Students answer at their own pace and you see results on a live leaderboard

test.title: Test mode
test.desc: Serious, no-frills assessment. No leaderboard, no timer pressure

homeworkDesc: Students join with a code and complete it any time before the deadline.
teacherDesc: You control the pace from the big screen. Everyone answers the same question together.

rows.timerSub: Use each question's time limit and give speed bonuses
rows.timerTeacherSub: Each question uses its own time limit. You can reveal early.
rows.anonymizeSub: Show fun names instead of real names on the leaderboard
rows.showAnswersSub: Validate only tells students if they were right
rows.deviceLockSub: Changing name on the same browser still counts as the same student. Turn off if students share computers.
